title: WATCH: Tapestry CEO Joanne Crevoiserat on CNBC’s Mad Money
summary: In a recent appearance on CNBC's Mad Money, Tapestry CEO Joanne Crevoiserat shared why our deep understanding of consumers is critical to building lasting brand
body_markdown:
By **mshakeel01@tapestry.com**


September 28, 2026 03:09 PM Eastern Daylight Time


In a recent appearance on CNBC’s Mad Money, Tapestry CEO Joanne Crevoiserat shared why our deep understanding of consumers is critical to building lasting brand connections. Throughout the conversation, Joanne reflected on how we earn the loyalty that turns first-time buyers into lifelong customers. In her words, “The best is yet to come. We’re just getting started.”


Watch the full interview below.
